propositions: An optional isolated backfill adapter must mine Claude Code session transcripts via error-signature grep (patterns like LLMUnavailableError, ConnectionError, ModuleNotFoundError) and deterministically classify matches into an enum (env_setup, dependency, integration, tooling, none) without LLM calls.
Every emitted classified record must carry source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified to honestly label low-confidence backfill data and segregate it from authoritative structural series.

The adapter must be quarantined behind the backfill script and never imported by core metrics modules (registry.py, __init__.py); a unit test must scan source to assert no adapter import exists in those files.

A unit test must validate that a fixture JSONL transcript with a known env-failure signature (e.g. ModuleNotFoundError) extracts and deterministically classifies into at least one interval with correct labels, and a clean transcript yields zero records.
The classification enum values, output JSON schema (kind, signature, ts, source, confidence), and the normative pattern-to-enum routing table must be defined in the adapter module.
